non_claims: live registry composition through the serve entry
browser_evidence_boundary: Headless Chrome cannot supply HTTP Basic credentials to a same-origin fetch or EventSource, a credentialed origin URL is rejected by fetch itself, the owner serves no credentials endpoint, and Chrome --screenshot against an unauthenticated origin writes no file while still exiting 0. The frozen DOM marker contract is therefore proven by the real-Chrome render test ui/teams-console/tests/render-d07.spec.ts, not by a live dump of the authenticated console.

refused_commands.permission.reply: UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION (no Session owner bound to the control daemon)
refused_commands.permission.reply.out-of-vocabulary-paylo: HTTP 400 from the closed ConsoleCommandV1 parser
refused_commands.history.kind=request: HTTP 502 with the owner's message and no typed code; the D06-owned history route drops a non-absence owner code, so the black box asserts the bare 502 and the absence of a code. The UI renders the refusal from the response message; typed-code rendering is a unit-level claim only.
